name: Modern Crem Bite
ingredients_raw: Cake (76%): Refined Wheat flour (Maida), Sugar, Liquid Glucose, Humectant (422, 420(i)), Refined Vegetable Oil (Palmolein), Milk Solids, Food Colour (150d), Cake Gel {Water, Emulsifiers (471, 477)}, Cocoa Solids (1%), Corn Starch, Raising Agents {500(ii), 503(i), 450(i)}, Iodized Salt, Preservatives (202, 200, 281, 223), Stabilizer (415), Emulsifiers {470(i), 472e, 475, 322(i)}, Acidity Regulators {270, 341(i), 330}, Nature-Identical Flavouring Substances. Center Creme (24%): Sugar, Hydrogenated Vegetable Fat, Liquid Glucose, Humectant (422), Cocoa Solids (2.5%), Milk Solids, Food Colour (150d), Emulsifier{322(i)}, Preservative (202), Iodized Salt, Nature-Identical Flavouring Substances. Contains Wheat, Soy and Milk
